summary: Define the local stage-gating contract for lead reconciliation without adding hooks, MCP, or permission changes.

local_rules: Treat candidate_leads as the authoritative ledger of named high-relevance discoveries.
Require exactly one normalized disposition per lead before candidate admission passes.
Require admitted non-fit candidates to appear in canonical metadata.json.
Preserve checked-negative evidence and distinguish ViShadow from ViSha/TVSD-Net.
Do not overstate ViShadow as fully trainable while training/evaluation code remains TODO.
local_contract.state_location: Each research run stores .research_flow/run_state.json and stage manifests under its output root.
local_contract.guard_policy: research_flow_guard.py blocks schema-v2 candidate admission on missing/duplicate/invalid dispositions and blocks metadata consolidation when admitted candidates are absent from metadata.json. Unit tests cover missing disposition, admitted-record, and merge-target cases.
local_contract.approval_and_secret_policy: No hooks, MCP, credentials, trust changes, destructive operations, or permission expansion are introduced; normal repository and web access policies continue to apply.
